fields.mechanism: Inter-turn short-circuit faults generate localized circulating currents that produce overheating even when the motor operates under no-load conditions.
fields.intervention: Apply negative-sequence current analysis utilizing wavelet-based filtering and symmetrical component decomposition to the 400V supply input of the conveyor drive motor to detect early-stage inter-turn short circuits that balanced phase winding resistance measurements fail to reveal.
fields.expected_effect: Identification of the specific faulted phase and location of the inter-turn short circuit, explaining the no-load overheating and enabling targeted rewinding or replacement before thermal overload trips occur.
fields.falsification_test: Measure the negative-sequence current magnitude using symmetrical component decomposition during the 20-minute no-load run; if the negative-sequence current remains below the detection index threshold while the motor still trips the thermal overload, the inter-turn short-circuit mechanism is disproved.
fields.mechanism_source_span: Inter-turn short-circuit faults in induction motors might lead to overheating, torque imbalances, and eventual motor failure.
